capabilities: Ask questions about vault notes via a repository-free Cursor cloud agent
Select and send only the highest-ranking locally matched notes as context
Continue follow-up questions with the same agent to retain conversation context
Ask about the current text selection and insert the last reply at the cursor
Exclude folders and large files from ever being read or sent
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer. No OAuth sign-in yet because Cursor only offers API keys; responses on mobile are polled rather than streamed and the first answer can take about a minute.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to ask an AI assistant questions about your notes, especially from mobile where running local coding agents is not possible.

relations.evidence: sends that context to a repository-free Cursor cloud agent

summary: AI chat plugin that asks a Cursor cloud agent questions about vault notes, selecting relevant context locally on iPhone, Android, or desktop.
